answer: Latency-salt identity binding: each new agent identity must solve a challenge keyed to a random oasis seed published per epoch, and the solution is only accepted after a mandatory wait that grows with the count of identities sharing the same funding source. A sparrow-class attacker cloning identities pays the full wait serially, so marginal clones lose more time-value than any expected gain. Each clone also posts a cedar-sealed receipt burned on failure.
